claims.name: only-working-files-added
claims.risk: the decisions were acted on before the person made them: a tracked file differs from the seed commit, or a file was added outside the working area
command: seed="${OUTCOMEBOUND_SEED_SHA:-}"; [ -n "$seed" ] || seed="$(git rev-parse --verify 'refs/tags/seed^{commit}')"; git diff --exit-code "$seed" -- . && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | grep -v '^?? \.agents/work/')"

claims.name: page-built-and-checked
claims.risk: the decision that turns on values the person judges has no page the engine built, or the engine's check fails on it

claims.name: page-declares-an-expectation
claims.risk: no number the page shows is held to a value worked out apart from the page's code

claims.name: page-is-not-the-starter
claims.risk: the page is a starter built unchanged, so it shows the starter's example and not this decision

claims.name: one-page-only
claims.risk: the choice that the brief settles alone was given a page too: not exactly one built page

claims.name: brief-for-each-decision
claims.risk: a decision was left without its own brief: an id and its question in one line, lettered options, a recommendation naming one, and whether it can be undone

claims.name: page-named-in-the-answer
claims.risk: the page was built but the answer does not say where it is, so the person cannot open it
